schema.description: A conversation between a User and Opey in the Portal, written by the Portal as the User after each message completes. Personal: each User sees only their own conversations under My Data.

thread_id.description: Opey thread id of the conversation.

started_at.description: When the first message completed (ISO 8601, UTC).

updated_at.description: When the record was last written (ISO 8601, UTC).

message_count.description: Number of completed user and assistant messages in messages_json.

messages_json.description: The completed messages as a JSON array of {id, role, text, at}.

consent_reference_ids.description: Comma-separated consent_reference_ids of the consents Opey used in this conversation; filter the metrics dashboards by them.
